locationPrompt.title: Find care near your live location?
locationPrompt.copy: Allow Swasthya Sarthi to use your device location for accurate nearby hospitals and doctors. Your browser will ask for permission next. If GPS is blocked, Swasthya Sarthi will use your approximate city, and you can still enter another location.
locationPrompt.note: Location is used for this care search. Personal health information remains protected behind sign-in.
